title: Anagram
statement: Implement `solve(left, right)`. Return 1 when the two strings are anagrams after casefold and after removing spaces. Punctuation, if present, counts. Return 0 otherwise.
hints: casefold and delete spaces on both sides.
Compare Counter values, or sorted strings.
Different lengths after cleaning cannot be anagrams.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An anagram is the same multiset of characters.

editorial: An anagram is the same multiset of characters. Sorting both cleaned strings makes that equality obvious. Counter is the same test and is linear. Forgetting to remove spaces makes a phrase fail against its squashed form.
